title: A status change is refused for a user who has just lost the right to delete
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-REVOKE-STATUS) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REVOKE-STATUS-ROLE), which starts with 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit', 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • {User-D} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • The Admin can cut {Role-D} down during the steps to 'Part Library & Inventory → View' only, with See Financial Data and every Settings permission unticked, so {User-D} becomes a user who cannot delete inventory parts while a screen is still open.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REVOKE-ST-A1) and {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-REVOKE-ST-B1) are active at {Location-A}, each with 2 in {Bin-A} and on no work order.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab in {User-D}'s window.
custom_steps:
1. In {User-D}'s window click the ⋮ actions menu and click Deactivate parts.
  2. Tick the {Part-A} row.
  3. Click Deactivate in the bar.
  4. Leave the confirmation open and do not confirm yet.
  5. In the Admin window go to Settings → Roles & Permissions, edit {Role-D}: in the Part Library and Inventory group untick Create & Edit and Delete (keep View), untick See Financial Data and every Settings permission, and click Save.
  6. In {User-D}'s window click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  7. Read the message shown.
  8. In the Admin window search {Part-A} on the Active tab.
  9. In the Admin window edit {Role-D} back to View, Create & Edit, Delete and See Financial Data, and click Save.
  10. In {User-D}'s window reload the page, search {Part-B} and click its row.
  11. Leave the dialog open.
  12. In the Admin window go to Settings → Roles & Permissions, edit {Role-D}: in the Part Library and Inventory group untick Create & Edit and Delete (keep View), untick See Financial Data and every Settings permission, and click Save.
  13. In {User-D}'s window click Delete Part.
  14. Read the message shown.
  15. In the Admin window search {Part-B} on the Active tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 6 and 13: If the screen closed or hid the control before you could click, write "not checked by hand" in the result comment for that item.
  • Step 7: The change is refused with an access denied error (a message that {User-D} is not allowed to do this); no "1 part updated." toast appears.
  • Step 8: {Part-A} is still on the Active tab: its status did not change.
  • Step 14: The delete is refused in the same way, with an access denied error.
  • Step 15: {Part-B} still exists. The status change and the delete were both refused for the same user in the same state: the system accepts a status change from exactly the users it accepts a delete from.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S8-N3, S8-R15 and the Story 8 context note, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 4.3 and 4.4 (bulk confirm), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Tech plan 7 Oct 2026, §9 Security and D14 (the server checks the same right as the inventory part delete). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N3: “If that user tries to set a part active or inactive by any route, the request is refused with an access denied error.”
  • S8-R15: “The system accepts a status change, a tracking change and an untracked part from exactly the users it accepts an inventory part delete from today.”
  • PRD Story 8 context note: “S8-N1 to S8-N3 hold for a user who cannot delete inventory parts today. The system checks that access itself, so hiding the controls is not the only protection.”
